E2912

`reactive.derived` must compute and return a value.

What

`reactive.derived` must compute and return a value.

Why

A derived value is recomputed from its signals, so its lambda has to return the new value (D-REACT1=B). A body that returns nothing is a side effect, not a value.

Fix

return a value from the body, or use `reactive.effect(() -> { … })` for a side effect.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2912: tests/ui/reactive_derived_returns_nothing.stderr.
